contract.task_clause:
For an autoregressive process to be considered stationary
Option A: The roots of the characteristic equation must all lie inside the unit circle
Option B: The roots of the characteristic equation must all lie on the unit circle
Option C: The roots of the characteristic equation must all lie outside the unit circle
Option D: The roots of the characteristic equation must all be less than one in absolute value
